name: What should I look for in a general contractor for an older home renovation?

mainEntity.name: What should I look for in a general contractor for an older home renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a general contractor for an older home renovation, look for extensive experience with similar projects, especially those involving older structures. Ensure they are licensed, insured, and have a strong portfolio of completed work. Check their references and read client testimonials to assess their communication skills, project management, and ability to handle unexpected challenges common in older homes. A good contractor will also demonstrate knowledge of local building codes specific to historic properties, if applicable.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for a general contractor with extensive experience in older home renovations, proper licensing, insurance, and strong references. Ensure they understand local building codes.
